Agents act.Evidence answers.

A tool response is only part of the story. ConseqaX keeps the response, the agent’s own report, independent readback and effect origin apart, so you can see what the record actually supports.

    HOW IT WORKS

    Declare. Read back.
    Explain.

    Refunds, deliveries, database writes. When an agent changes something, keep the intention, the history and independent readback together.

    1. 01 / CAPTURE

      Declare the outcome first.

      Register a contract before the action: what must hold, by when, how many times. A run can register several actions, and an outcome with several parts is one all_of or any_of contract. The recorder keeps dispatches, responses and what the agent reported.

      rec = TraceRecorder(
    "agent-loop", actor=AGENT)
refund = rec.register(
    "refund-o-17", "issue_refund",
    ORDER, contract=CONTRACT)
with refund.attempt() as attempt:
    issue_refund(ORDER, attempt)
    2. 02 / READ BACK

      Check beyond the tool.

      Read your system of record through a separate read-only path. The built-in record verifier checks rows, orders or tickets, and CompositeVerifier checks each part against its own source; stale, incomplete or unavailable readback stays unknown.

      VERIFIER = RecordVerifier(
    scope_fields=("order_id",))
receipt = refund.verify(
    readback, verifier=VERIFIER)
receipt.status.value  # "satisfied"
receipt.origin.value  # "confirmed"
    3. 03 / EXPLAIN

      See what the record supports.

      Compare the agent’s report with verified state and origin, then decide whether a retry would duplicate the effect.

      ex = explain(rec.trace())
ex.actions[0].assessment_alignment
# "contradicted"
retry_advice(receipt).advice
# "do_not_retry"

    ↳You define success and establish source trust. ConseqaX preserves and explains the evidence you supply; a graph link does not establish causal necessity. Values are from the tested SQLite agent-loop example (timeout after commit; ConseqaX 2.1).

          01 / EVIDENCE CONTINUITY
          
    Every witness stays.
    
          
    A later readback does not rewrite the earlier one. In the delayed_reconciled trace, the first verification stays unknown after the second resolves it.
    
        
    
        
    
          
    
            
    report.htmlMINIMAL DISCLOSURE

          02 / INTENTIONAL DISCLOSURE
          
    Share a smaller surface.
    
          
    Default reports omit captured payloads and raw identifiers and use local aliases. Field omission is not anonymization; timing and structure stay visible.
    
        
    
        
    
          
    
            
    my-report.htmlNO SCRIPTS · NO NETWORK
    
          
    
          03 / LOCAL BY DESIGN
          
    One file. No server.
    
          
    Reports open directly in a browser with no JavaScript, remote assets, model, API key or hosted account. Keep the original trace as the record.
    
        
    
      
    
    
    

    
    
      
    
        
     FITS YOUR STACK
    Your framework.
    Same evidence.
    
        Read the framework guide →
      
    
      
    
        
    
          OPENAI AGENTS SDK
          @consequential_tool(calls=calls)
          
    In place of function_tool. Records each call, its errors and the SDK’s own tool timeout.
    
          consequa-x[openai-agents]
        
    
        
    
          LANGCHAIN
          ConsequaCallbackHandler(calls)
          
    A callback handler for tool runs, including errors a tool handles itself. LangGraph agents run tools the same way.
    
          consequa-x[langchain]
        
    
        
    
          CLAUDE AGENT SDK
          hooks=consequa_hooks(calls)
          
    Pre- and post-tool-use hooks that only observe. They never block or change a call.
    
          consequa-x[claude-agent-sdk]
        
    
        
    
          OPENTELEMETRY
          consequa-x otel-export trace.json
          
    execute_tool spans as the GenAI conventions name them, or start a trace from the tool spans you already have.
    
          consequa-x[otel]
        
    
      
    
      
    ↳Optional extras: the core still has no runtime dependency. You decide which calls are consequential; a tool response is never treated as verification. Tested offline against each SDK’s own machinery, not with a live model.
